title: docs(objectui): say the Console renders on phones; drop native and offline mobile claims
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RVTLrANiTaESzobMMD4Bb6)_

Fixes #29315

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：ObjectUI 协议的两页客户文档(index、concept)不再宣称 iOS/Android/桌面原生渲染和离线移动端;改成实情：一份定义由 Console 在桌面和手机上渲染，移动 App 是承载 Console 的原生壳。
- **为什么改**：文档承诺了平台没交付的能力(AGENTS.md 首要指令第 10 条：声明≠交付);`mobile_renderer` 示例连 spec 都没有这个键，后面还挂着没测过的省钱数字。
- **风险与回滚**：只动两份 mdx,不碰代码、不发布;回滚就是 revert 这一个 commit。
- **先看**:`content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx`(「One Definition, Every Screen」与末尾渲染器表);`content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx`(架构图与「Field Teams on Phones」)。
- **两分钟验证**：在本分支跑卡上的 re-check grep(见 Verification),应无任何输出。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Both pages now say what is delivered: one definition, rendered by the Console in desktop and phone browsers, and the ObjectStack mobile app as a native shell hosting that same Console (the shell bridge is described in `ui/packages/mobile/src/nativeHost.ts`). The server-driven UI argument is kept; it holds for the Console.

`index.mdx`
- "Write Once, Run Everywhere" card (claimed native rendering on iOS SwiftUI, Android Compose, Desktop Tauri): now "One Definition, Every Screen", the Console on desktop and phones.
- Architecture diagram: the three native renderers (React / Swift / Tauri) are replaced by the Console, which serves desktop browsers, phone browsers and the mobile app.
- "Mobile app? Same YAML file renders natively": now the Console renders the same file on a phone.
- FormView "Renders as" (Material-UI tabs / SwiftUI NavigationView / native desktop tabs): now a tabbed form in the Console, one tab per section.
- "Offline-First Mobile Apps": deleted, with its `mobile_renderer` block (no spec key) and its $100K/year figure. Replaced by "Field Teams on Phones", which states the delivered path and makes no offline claim.

`concept.mdx`
- Step 4 of the metadata pipeline ("web, iOS, Android refresh layout"): now every screen gets the layout on its next load through the Console.
- "Write Once, Run Anywhere (For Real This Time)" with SwiftUI and Compose renderer code: now "One Definition, Every Screen", one renderer (the Console) on every screen.
- Server-driven UI diagrams: the client-driven box is now "Client App Bundle"; the server-driven client is "Browser or the mobile app" running the Console as the generic renderer. Benefits reworded to match (no new app build, new UI on next load).
- "Map JSON types to native widgets": now "the renderer's components".
- "Platform-Specific Renderers" table (a React + Material-UI renderer "in progress", and planned Vue, Flutter, SwiftUI, Compose and Tauri renderers): replaced by the one renderer that ships, the Console, and a sentence that the mobile app hosts it.

The problem statements that describe traditional native development (three native code bases, app store review waits) stay: they argue for the server-driven approach and promise nothing.

## Tests

Docs only, no package touched, so no package test or typecheck is owed. The derived docs gates ran on head `756e8e33`, results under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- Unmeasured business figures that do not concern mobile stay, outside this card: `index.mdx` "Multi-Tenant SaaS Customization" ($2M/year) and "Regulatory Compliance Agility" ($500K fine); `concept.mdx` "10×" feature velocity, "50% Reduction in Frontend Costs" ($500K/year) and a second $500K fine. Noted, not filed.
- The YAML snippets in `index.mdx` "Real-World Use Cases" (`layout: { columns: 3 }`, `theme: …`, `formview.eu.yml: fields: …`) and the `GET /api/v1/ui/view/…` route in `concept.mdx` were not checked against the spec or the route table. Noted, not filed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Re-check grep from the card, before (origin/main 385ea1cc) and after (756e8e33)</summary>

Command: `grep -n "renders natively\|Offline-First Mobile\|mobile_renderer\|Mobile App Bundle" content/docs/protocol/objectui/*.mdx`

Before:

```text
content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx:250:│                   Mobile App Bundle                   │
content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx:33:    description="One JSON definition renders natively on Web (React/Vue), iOS (SwiftUI), Android (Compose), Desktop (Tauri)."
content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx:183:- Mobile app? Same YAML file renders natively (zero code)
content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx:495:### Offline-First Mobile Apps
content/docs/protocol/objectui/index.mdx:507:mobile_renderer:
```

After: no output, grep exit 1.

A wider grep on head (`natively|native|offline|swiftui|compose|tauri|flutter|ios|android`, case-insensitive) leaves only the traditional-approach problem statements and the sentences saying the mobile app is a native shell around the Console.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates on 756e8e33</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 43 commands; all 43 ran, each with stdin from /dev/null, and all exited 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` first refused with exit 3 (client-react not built); after building the `@objectstack/client-react` closure it exited 0 (346 prose examples type-check). `--ran` reconciliation: 43 derived, 43 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

Families include `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-frontmatter`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:docs-redirects`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:docs-section-name`, `check:section-landing-index`, `check:nul-bytes` and the spec `check:docs`. CI type-check lanes and the Test Core shard planner are CI's own and were not run locally.

</details>
